assets.name: Neople
assets.type: Official transparent Neople footer identity within CSS sprite
assets.notes: Gray and yellow brand mark plus WE MAKE WONDERS! slogan, transparent backdrop. Use CSS background-position or an overflow viewport, without changing bitmap data. neople-official.png is a separate low-resolution Korean footer asset with opaque background and is not recommended.

work: All downloads are unmodified source assets. Extracted PNGs only decode the exact embedded original image bytes from official SVGs. alpha-analysis.json contains read-only pixel analysis; no bitmap editing was performed.
